**Subject: Immediate action regarding the sermon series**

Dear Sterling,

Two elders raised doctrinal concerns about last night’s sermon. We currently have no recording or transcript, and we have not yet obtained Mir’s response.

The remaining sessions are cancelled. Leadership will preserve the reports, seek Mir’s response, and determine any further action under the church’s governing procedures. We cannot responsibly promise permanent expulsion before completing those steps.

Any decision concerning your pledge remains yours.

Sincerely,  
[Name and title]

My recommendation: cancel the series now, make no doctrinal finding or permanent-expulsion promise, and begin a documented review today.
